terms.gloss: a promise, secured by bail, to appear before a court on a fixed day; bail, recognizance
evidence: Gai. Inst. 4.184: vadimōnium eī faciendum est, id est, ut prōmittat, sē certō diē sistī (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: vadimōnium eī faciendum est, id est, ut prōmittat, sē certō diē sistī
phrases.english: he must give bail, that is, promise that he will appear on a fixed day
